DEF-2.statement: research/gmi-novel-intelligence-w4-prospective-v1 -- the revival package that re-earned prospectiveness under a genuinely pre-committed freeze -- is not scored at all. No row anywhere in THEOREM_SCORES_V2.json mentions POST_HOC, and substring 'novel-intelligence-w4' over all 197 full rows returns exactly one hit, the parent's.
DEF-2.root_cause_temporal: The rescore merged at f4020d06 2026-09-16T14:58:50+02:00; the audit at c4def870 2026-09-16T19:04:05+02:00. The rescore could not have seen the verdict and was never refreshed.
DEF-2.root_cause_structural: Recorded as gap G-NAME. The v2 arrivals inclusion rule filters by the directory-name glob gmi-833-*. A revival package that re-earns a property for a non-gmi-833-* parent can never enter the scored population through that glob, at any later date. This is what makes the class recur, and it is why the disproved parent kept its M4 while the package that re-earned one was missing.

name_resolution_null.design: 200 seeded draws; each takes a real scored package name and appends a suffix no package carries
name_resolution_null.caveat: a miss is guaranteed by construction; this is NOT evidence of selectivity

permutation_null.design: 200 seeded draws; each re-points all 29 adverse entries at randomly chosen REAL scored packages and counts UNREFLECTED flags
permutation_null.honest_negative: The true count does NOT beat this null: 3 sits inside the bulk of the permuted distribution, and 129 of 200 random draws flag at least as many. About a fifth of the 49 scored packages hold an M4/FROZEN_HELDOUT row mentioning no finding, so a random re-pointing hits one about as often as the real register does. The flag COUNT is therefore not evidence on its own and is not offered as such. What carries the evidence is WHICH packages are flagged: hostile H2 (the checker flags the real W4 row as published, and zero after the delta), H3 and H3b (two real adverse packages that must NOT be flagged, one holding 12 M4/FROZEN_HELDOUT rows), and the downstream adjudication of every flag against the artifact.

freeze_conformance_disclosures.why_this_section_exists: Self-disclosed refinements of FREEZE_V3_W4.md, recorded here rather than left for a reader to discover. Neither widens any claim; both are strictly more conservative than the frozen text.

D1_outcome_typing.freeze_said: P6 types every adverse verdict into exactly one of three outcomes: REFLECTED, UNREFLECTED, OUT_OF_SCORED_POPULATION.
D1_outcome_typing.delivered: Five states. REFLECTED_OR_IMMATERIAL_TO_SCORE (defined in freeze section 4 but not named in P6's list) and NOT_ADVERSE__SELF_TYPED_SCREEN_FALSE_POSITIVE (not named in the freeze at all). REFLECTED itself is empty, count 0.
D1_outcome_typing.direction: Strictly narrower than REFLECTED in both cases, so strictly more conservative: folding either into REFLECTED would assert that a finding IS reflected in a score, which neither case establishes.
D1_outcome_typing.why_NOT_ADVERSE_was_necessary: Without it, machine-intelligence-morphogenesis-v1 -- which the register itself types a screen false positive, 'no prospective claim' -- would be treated as adverse and its 12 M4/FROZEN_HELDOUT rows would all flag. That is hostile H3b, and it is the single largest false-positive risk in this check.

D2_downstream_adjudication.freeze_said: P6 defines the sweep's typing; section 6 requires that every finding be verified before it is reported.
D2_downstream_adjudication.delivered: A downstream per-flag adjudication step (field W4R4_adjudication) that verifies each UNREFLECTED flag against the artifact. It does not alter the sweep's typing; it records whether a flag survives verification.
D2_downstream_adjudication.effect: One of the two flagged packages, gmi-833-g0-grammar-growth-v1, does not survive: its M4 is SUSTAINED and nothing about it is changed. Without this step the package would have reported a cry-wolf finding.

ref_discipline: The executor runs git history queries against HEAD rather than the SOURCE_MAIN literal so the checks also run on a PR head. That is sound exactly when SOURCE_MAIN is an ancestor of HEAD -- asserted by the executor and by a test -- and every pinned blob still matches, since the first-add commits being read are historical and cannot move under a descendant ref.
